tuning_key.text: But what is life for if not sharing it / With someone that you submit / To a deep love that seems to fit
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Life opens when you transmit joy toward a presence that receives you completely. The fit expands what you can hold, and the world returns bright bursts of shared brilliance.

practice.title: Feel the Fit
practice.instruction: Soften your shoulders and jaw until you sense the exact moment your body agrees to share space with the world around you.

practice.title: Transmit the Brightness
practice.instruction: Exhale a soundless hum of delight from your chest, letting it radiate outward without needing a destination.

practice.title: Receive the Echo
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and let the bright bursts appear as irregular brilliance moving through you.

What you transmit is the frequency of harmony that creates space for love to fit, expanding the attention field through practical elegance. The bright scatter of this fit manifests as ease in the operations you hold.
